minors.2.1: Adds the optional trace_id correlation field

rules: A reader accepts a record whose major equals the contract major and whose minor is at least oldest_minor; a newer minor is additive and accepted.
Every contract permits extension at the top level and inside extensions; the authority object permits none.
Authority fields live only in the closed authority object; an authority name outside it, or an unknown name inside it, is refused.
Every record names execution_id, task_id and task_generation in its authority, except the error envelope.
A relay keeps every unknown optional field and its value on read, modify and write.
A consumer vendors these schema files and validates with a JSON Schema 2020-12 validator; it never imports the owner's runtime package.
Schemas reference only urn:swarm-v2 identifiers inside this directory.
Rollback lowers write_minor so producers write the previous minor while readers keep accepting both.
Schemas fix wire layout; the field tables and examples in plan section 22 list field sets, and their authority fields travel inside the authority object.
These contracts publish checkpoint_sequence and renewal_sequence; SV2-CKP-04 orders checkpoints when it promotes the latest pointer, and SV2-LDG-02 orders heartbeat renewals.
Admission fences each task across every contract: an older task_generation, or another execution at the accepted generation, is refused as stale_generation.

SV2-LDG-02 types two optional heartbeat fields every 2.x minor already admitted as top-level extension: archive_watermark, the worker-reported durable archive watermark (default 0), and resources, resource telemetry that never schedules or extends a lease (default empty).
